unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 外向的；爱交际的；友好的；外出的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm not outgoing so I'm a little anxious right now.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 组合词：out（向外）+ going（走去的）= 爱交际的，外向的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience and love.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：patient（有耐心的）的名词形式 → patience（耐心）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 图案；模式；方式；模型 `v.` 构成图案(或花样)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She wore a lovely dress decorated with a delicate flower pattern.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 生活常识：dress pattern（服装花样），weather pattern（天气模式）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Over eighty per cent of the students passed the final exam.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：per（每一）+ cent（百）→ 每一百个中的数量 → 百分之……。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Some resolutions are about physical health.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: physics（物理）衍生出身体的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm going to study Physics.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: phys(身体/物质) + ics(学科) = 物理

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Lang Lang is an internationally famous Chinese classical pianist.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：piano（钢琴）+ -ist（……家）→ 钢琴演奏家。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 高原(在一段时期的发展后)保持稳定水平
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is the highest plateau in the world.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: plat（平）+ eau（水）-> 高原像高处平坦的水面

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Passengers waited patiently on the railway platform for the train to arrive.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：plat（平的）+ form（形状，台子）→ 平台，火车站台。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 开玩笑的；逗笑的，顽皮的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Small and playful
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: play (玩耍) + ful (充满...的) = 充满玩耍欲望的，爱玩的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is keenly interested in world politics and current affairs.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：polit-（市民，政体）+ -ics（学科/事务）→ 政治学，政治。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Factories must not pour dirty waste into rivers to pollute clean water.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 环保词汇：pollute the environment（污染环境），pollution（污染）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My grandmother prepared a warm bowl of rice porridge for breakfast.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 生活常识：早上喝的热乎乎的白米粥、燕麦粥叫 porridge。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Applicants can apply for this position from June 3, 2024 to July 31, 2024.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：pos（放置）+ ition（名词后缀） -> 摆放的位置，即“职位；位置”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 积极的；肯定的 `n.` 优势；优点
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Try to stay positive and active.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：pos (放置) + itive -> 摆放得稳固的，引申为确定的、积极的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Could you possibly help me carry this heavy box upstairs?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 礼貌请求：Could you possibly...（您能不能……）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If someone set me free, I would make them rich and powerful.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: power力量+ful满满的=**强大的**。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Time is as precious as gold, so we should make good use of every minute.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谚语联想：一寸光阴一寸金，precious（宝贵的，珍贵的）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He predicted the earth of the future would have many TV stations.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pre(提前) + dict(说) = 预测。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: That's when many young people start to experience social pressure and stress from school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：press（按压）+ ure（名词后缀） -> 被按压的感觉，即“压力”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They pretended to make the clothes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pre前+tend伸展：在人前伸出假面具**假装**。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wearing masks and washing hands frequently can help prevent diseases.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 核心短语：prevent somebody from doing something（阻止某人做某事）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：pri(个人) + vate(玩特) -> 私人有特权，可以尽情玩特长。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fu Xing learnt about the cleaning process.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pro（向前）+ cess（走）：向前走的路程就是过程。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We can now sell local products to tourists.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀: produce(生产) -> product(产品)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eggs, fish, and milk are all rich sources of healthy protein.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 营养常识：人体发育所必需的高蛋白质（protein）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: the old ginkgo tree in the Zhongnan Mountains in Shaanxi Province
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 在这个省份 (province) 游说，说服 (convince) 了很多人。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The publishing company will publish the author's new storybook next month.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：public（公众的）衍生动词 → publish（向公众出版发行）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The Great Pyramid of Giza is one of the seven wonders of the ancient world.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 世界奇观：古埃及的吉萨大金字塔（the Great Pyramid）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: AI will improve the quality of our future life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: qual + ity -> 产品或人的品质、质量。
